Let me share my dental experience with Dr. Bongkochrat.
I've had a problem with my lower teeth overlapping my upper teeth since childhood. I had jaw surgery and orthodontics to correct it, but due to my tongue constantly pushing against my teeth, the problem persisted even after retirement. That's when I consulted Dr. Bongkochrat.
She didn't give a definitive answer, but offered three treatment options so I could make my own decision.
I chose to have four lower teeth that were misaligned, eroded at the neck, protruding, and spaced apart, extracted and replaced with six new crowns, preserving my natural teeth on both sides as a base. Initially, I was very worried because extracting four teeth isn't easy, but Dr. Bongkochrat didn't disappoint. The process was smooth. She administered local anesthesia before injecting local anesthetic, took impressions, extracted the teeth, and placed temporary crowns while I waited a week for the permanent crowns. Everything went according to plan, but the results exceeded my expectations. My face changed; my chin, which used to protrude because of my lower teeth, became more symmetrical, and my face improved significantly. Friends asked what I'd done, saying I looked prettier. Later, my upper teeth developed decay and discoloration. This was an easy decision to pursue. Six crowns were also made on the upper teeth to ensure a perfect bite and matching color.
I highly recommend this clinic for anyone with oral and dental problems. The dentist is lovely and in a good mood. Most importantly, it's painless, or only slightly painful. The price is reasonable. Many thanks to the dentist and all the staff.
